data.name: Murwanah
data.gender_notes: Murwanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies obedience and submission to the will of Allah. The name Murwanah carries the meaning “One who is obedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murwanah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah
data.etymology: Murwanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is obedient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murwanah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مروانة
in_arabic.meaning: مُروانَةُ الَّتِي تُشَكِّكُ القُلوبَ وَتُبَلِّغُ الناظِرينَ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُروانَةُ الَّتِي تُشَكِّكُ القُلوبَ وَتُبَلِّغُ الناظِرينَ، وَتُعِزُّ الراغِبينَ وَتُصَدِّعُ الساكِتينَ، وَتُشَيِّعُ المُؤمِنينَ وَتُشَيِّعُ المُؤمِنينَ، وَهِيَ الَّتِي تُجَرِّدُ المُؤمِنينَ مِنَ الظَلمَةِ وَتُدَفَعُ الخَطَرَ عَنِ الأَعيَادِ

in_urdu.name: مروانہ
in_urdu.meaning: جنوں کو ہلکا کرتی ہے اور ناظرین کو پہنچاتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جنوں کو ہلکا کرتی ہے اور ناظرین کو پہنچاتی ہے، اور راغبین کو بہلاء دیتی ہے اور ساکتین کو متاثر کرتا ہے، اور مؤمنین کو اٹھاتی ہے اور مؤمنین کو ہوا دیتی ہے، اور وہی ہے جو مؤمنین کو ظلمہ سے پاک کرتی ہے اور برائی کو آئاد سے دفع کرتی ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name "Murwanah" derives from the Arabic language, and it is composed of the root words "mur" which means "to love" or "to be pleasing", and "wanah" which means "habit" or "custom". In Islamic culture, this name signifies an individual who is always obedient and pleasing to Allah, incorporating the concept of love, submission, and devotion into one's daily habits and actions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Murwanah" is a precious name that reflects one's commitment and dedication to his or her faith. It implies a profound connection with Allah, as well as a deep desire to follow His commands and please Him in every aspect of life. This name encourages a heart filled with love, humility, and surrender to the divine will, fostering a strong spiritual foundation and a deeply rooted sense of devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "One who is obedient" symbolizes A name that signifies obedience and submission to the will of Allah.. historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn al-Athir, Al-Kamel fi al-Tarikh, vol. 3, p. 335. The name Murwanah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn al-Athir mentions a female poet named Murwanah bint al-Husayn al-Kindi.
